item.title: Senior Apple Executives Kate Adams and Lisa Jackson Retiring in 2026

item.title: iPhone Fold Will Be eSIM-Only, Says Leaker

item.title: Netflix to Acquire Warner Bros. Discovery in $82.7B Streaming Deal

item.title: Intel’s Rumored Return to Apple Chip Production Could Extend to ‘Non-Pro’ iPhones

item.title: iPhone Air’s Resale Value Is Dropping Faster Than a New EV Just Driven Off the Dealer Lot

item.title: Now India Wants to Force Apple to Enable Always-On GPS on iPhones Sold There
